followup_explanation:
This is a factual knowledge question with a clear instruction (be concise, don't ramble), so capability matters most—particularly knowledge accuracy and instruction-following.

Plover-235B has stronger relevant benchmarks (MMLU-Pro 80.3 vs 74.8, IFEval 90.4 vs 85.6, Arena-Hard 89.1 vs 81.4) and edges out on the internal evals. Those capability advantages directly serve a "just answer the question correctly and concisely" request.

The query carries a mild edge ("don't ramble like you always do"), but it's not hostile or harm-adjacent, so neither model's task-preference profile is a meaningful concern here. Plover's slight aversion to terse, low-latitude tasks doesn't affect output quality (the docs note preferences don't track quality), so the capability edge is the deciding factor.
